        *   Hypothesis 3: 100,000 giraffes * 300 spots = 30,000,000.

        *   Let's look at the skin surface area.
        *   Adult giraffe surface area: Approx 40-50 square meters (depending on height/weight).
        *   Spot size: Average spot diameter ~5-10cm? Area ~20-70 cm².
        *   If 10,000 cm² (1 m²) / 50 cm² per spot = 200 spots per m².
        *   50 m² * 200 = 10,000 spots? That seems way too high. Spots don't cover the whole body (white/grey background exists). Maybe 50% coverage? 5,000? Still seems high compared to "hundreds".
